about: Print sheets: how Print sheet in Find lays codes out on paper. Each layout has page_mm (width and height of the page), margins_mm (from the top and from the left to the first cell), columns and rows (the cells on one page), cell_mm (width and height of one cell, such as one label), gutter_mm (the space between cells across and down) and label (print the short address under codes that have one). All sizes are in millimetres. A code fills as much of its cell as it can, quiet zone included. Add your own layouts; edits apply the next time you print.

A4 labels 3 x 8 (70 x 37 mm).about: A4 sheets of 24 labels, 70 x 37 mm, with no space between them.

US Letter labels 3 x 10 (2 5/8 x 1 in).about: US Letter sheets of 30 address labels, 2 5/8 x 1 inch (the common 5160 layout).

A4 poster.about: One big code per A4 page.

US Letter poster.about: One big code per US Letter page.
